subject.title: Preview session workspace images and unsupported files

question: Should the optional `mimeType`, `contentEncoding`, and `previewKind` fields become the canonical shared session-file preview contract for web and native clients?
rationale: The implementation is focused and technically sound, but the protected maintainer label and generated cross-client protocol surface require explicit owner acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept the additive contract
options.body: Land after required exact-head protocol, UI, Swift/native, and CI checks complete successfully.

options.title: Request a web-specific seam
options.body: Keep the user-facing feature but avoid expanding the shared session-file model by defining a narrower Control UI contract.

options.title: Defer binary previews
options.body: Retain current text-only viewing and editing and postpone image and unsupported-binary handling.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive contract
recommendation.body: Land after required exact-head protocol, UI, Swift/native, and CI checks complete successfully.
